entries.speaker: Shadow Attendant
entries.en: Inconceivable. How have you managed[n]to make it this far...?

entries.speaker: Shadow Attendant
entries.en: You truly are pests... Every time you[n]think you've crushed them, they just[n]come crawling back in.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I hope you're ready. We didn't appreciate[n]that trap of yours.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: He's right! You didn't have any intention[n]of letting us get past that maze in the first[n]place!

entries.speaker: Shadow Attendant
entries.en: Ah, you are indeed correct! That is how[n]things are supposed to be. You're not[n]worthy of victory.

entries.speaker: Shadow Attendant
entries.en: Now, won't you just lie down and lose[n]for me? This isn't an easy job, you know.

entries.speaker: Shadow Attendant
entries.en: Awww, is that so? Well then, it seems[n]I have no other choice...!

entries.speaker: Shadow Attendant
entries.en: Oh, that's too bad... but it seems I have[n]no other choice...!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: That must have been his plan from the[n]very beginning.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Considering how things were on the[n]members floor, it's no surprise this[n]isn't a fair game either.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: And yet we still reached our goal.[n]Come now, let us go. We have no[n]more business here.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm, we will have to go to another game[n]if we want to win more coins...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Joker, should we go back to the[n]reception area at once?
